text: Visitors have noted issues with signage and accessibility, particularly the lack of clear directions to handicap parking and limited shuttle service for those needing assistance from the parking area to the entrance. Several reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as poorly executed and detracting from the experience. Some visitors were frustrated by timed entry policies, including long waits to enter without advance tickets. Food options in the café received negative comments for limited and unsatisfactory choices. Despite these concerns, many found the architecture and interactive exhibits engaging, though some felt the overall content was less impressive than expected.
